name: Sparse Octree Filtering with Node Map
definition: A 2D node map derived from the light-view map, acting as a MIP-map pyramid, to reduce the number of threads launched during filtering by terminating redundant threads.
summary: Sparse Octree Filtering with Node Map reduces MIP-map generation overhead by using a 2D node map to detect redundant threads targeting the same octree node and terminate all but one.
